description.value:
This subcompact pistol is an ode to perfectionism. Made as a middle ground between competition and military standards, the P-2020’s rapid-cycling action, integrated smartlinking, nigh perfect machine tolerances, and bi-modal trigger allow it to spew rounds without compromising accuracy or reliability. Its creator is of some note, as Hammond Industries appeared out of nowhere a decade ago, producing machinery and weapons of exceedingly high quality. Nobody is entirely sure if they’re just a lucky neocorp or the puppet of a shadowy billionaire, but regardless of their motives, the P-2020 is just one example of their clear strive for perfection.

Cost: 1,100eb (Very Expensive)

Class: Excellent Quality Medium Pistol • Skill: Handgun • Range: Pistol

Damage: 2d6 • Capacity: 12 • ROF: 2 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: Yes

Slots: 1 • Attachments: Binary Trigger, Smartgun Link • Mods: None

Special Features: When using this weapon to make an Aimed Shot, it deals 1d6 additional damage (3d6). When firing this weapon in Single Shot, the user may choose to expend double the amount of ammunition (2 Total) and suffer a -2 penalty to their Attack Check. If this attack hits, the user adds +2 to its total damage before it interacts with the target’s armor [Binary Trigger]. Incompatible with Solenoid Mechanism.

Range: Pistol
Pre-installed: Binary Trigger, Smartgun Link (effects already included in these stats)

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
